hero.title: Guru Kashi University
hero.summary: Guru Kashi University’s Faculty of Agriculture at Talwandi Sabo combines crop study with experimental farms and specialised production units. Students encounter soil, crop protection, horticulture and seed work alongside classroom study. The four-year agriculture bachelor’s degree offers a broad route into this academic setting.

overview.heading: Crop science and farm demonstrations at Talwandi Sabo
paragraphs: GKU’s agriculture programme page describes study in crop production, soil science, plant breeding, biotechnology and agribusiness. It lists a four-year bachelor’s degree and provides a defined school-level entry requirement. The wider agriculture faculty also offers postgraduate routes, which applicants should compare as separate programme choices.

Its facilities page gives specific examples of practical infrastructure: experimental farms, protected cultivation, seed technology and silkworm work. These are useful indicators of the school’s teaching context. The university’s general admissions procedure describes application scrutiny, merit-based provisional allocation and original-document checking. A dated agriculture fee schedule is still needed to turn the academic comparison into a reliable cost comparison.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: A broad agriculture degree with published crop, resource and agribusiness subject areas.
programmes.eligibility: Official page states 50% in 10+2 PCB/PCBM/PCM/Agriculture, or 50% in a two- or three-year agriculture/allied diploma after Class 10.
programmes.admission_route: General procedure describes application scrutiny and merit-based allocation; confirm the course-specific notice.

fees.note: An academic-year-specific official fee schedule for this programme was not verified.

programmes.icar_scope_note: Listed under Faculty of Agriculture; accreditation term 2024-03-29 to 2029-03-28.

admissions.heading: Applying to GKU
admissions.intro: GKU’s general process moves from application and scrutiny to provisional allocation, eligibility verification, fee payment and final allotment.

steps.title: Submit the application
steps.text: The procedure permits online or offline registration.

steps.title: Complete verification
steps.text: Original documents are checked for eligibility before the university’s final seat allotment.

campus.heading: Agricultural teaching and practical work
campus.intro: The agriculture faculty documents teaching and research resources across production, protection and resource management.

facilities.name: Experimental and demonstration farms
facilities.description: Field areas support crop research and student training.

facilities.name: Protected cultivation units
facilities.description: Polyhouses support horticultural and crop-diversification work.

facilities.name: Seed technology and processing facilities
facilities.description: The faculty identifies seed testing, treatment and production research resources.

practical_learning: The faculty FAQ describes live projects, internships and field training.
The facilities page identifies vermicomposting and silkworm-rearing units.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: GKU’s policy describes several fee-concession routes. Its early-admission windows are dated in 2026 and should not be treated as open-ended offers. Written confirmation of programme applicability and combination rules remains necessary.

schemes.name: Special Meritorious Scholarship
schemes.details: The published policy sets first-semester tuition concessions by qualifying-class marks, excludes Ph.D. and restricts combination with government schemes or study packages. Confirm the applicable intake policy.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: GKU publishes university-wide placement support information. The general admissions page’s promotional placement wording is not a dated agriculture cohort report, so no agriculture placement rate or salary is quoted.

recognition.heading: Recognition and programme accreditation
recognition.text: The audited ICAR register identifies Faculty of Agriculture with validity from 2024-03-29 to 2029-03-28. The programme labels below preserve the register’s scope; other institutional degrees are not covered by inference.

faculty.intro: The official Faculty of Agriculture directory identifies these teachers and roles. The page was checked on 31 October 2026 but does not state appointment-effective dates.

faqs.question: Where is GKU’s agriculture faculty located?
faqs.answer: Guru Kashi University is at Talwandi Sabo in Bathinda district, Punjab.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. Agriculture?
faqs.answer: The programme page lists four years.

faqs.question: Can an agriculture diploma holder apply?
faqs.answer: The official course page includes qualifying two- or three-year agriculture/allied diploma routes after Class 10, subject to its 50% requirement.

faqs.question: What specialised practical units are documented?
faqs.answer: The faculty identifies protected cultivation, seed technology, vermicomposting and sericulture resources.

faqs.question: Which degree is covered by this ICAR record?
faqs.answer: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture under the Faculty of Agriculture, from 29 March 2024 to 28 March 2029.

faqs.question: Is an agriculture fee amount verified here?
faqs.answer: The course page provides no amount. The recovered 2025–26 scanned prospectus did not yield a verified agriculture fee in the inspected pages; a dated, itemised programme quote is still needed.
